mnq_intraday_falsification.note: Three-paper cluster by Mesfin (same author, same 2021-2025 MNQ dataset). Progressive falsification: 14 signal families → VVG regime ID → ML architectures. All fail after costs under walk-forward. Single-author — needs independent replication.

defi_carry_mechanics.note: Three papers on spot-perp delta-neutral carry (Krestenko, Le, Lorig). Realized performance predominantly driven by funding environment. HL funding follows OU-plus-jump dynamics. Exit asymmetry documented.

ml_portfolio_hac_robustness.note: ML/RL fails to produce statistically significant excess returns under HAC-robust inference. Best forecast MSE != best portfolio Sharpe.

regime_conditional_trend_scaling.note: Practitioner sources: optimal trend allocation is regime-dependent. Mozes vol-spike mechanism documents why Strategy A v3 MaxDD was breached. RegimeFilterHandler stub blocks automated testing.

backtest_integrity_multiple_testing.note: Effective-N AMTP correction critical: 274 raw tests, effective N likely 3-4 for correlated iteration series like Strategy C iter_1→iter_10.

open_hypotheses.description: Funding rate mean-reversion speed (OU theta) on HL perpetuals predicts carry quality: high theta (fast reversion) → noisy carry, reduce Strategy B position size; low theta (persistent regime) → sticky carry, hold or increase.
open_hypotheses.data_required: HL 8h funding rates BTC/ETH/SOL (data/funding_carry/, ~7 months from Oct 2025)

open_hypotheses.description: Vol-ratio position scalar for Strategy A v4: position = tanh_signal × clamp(vol_28d / vol_5d, 0.5, 2.0). Scales down when near-term vol is expanding faster than medium-term baseline, reducing crash-regime exposure that caused the propfirm breach.

methodology_flags.description: Heavy-tailed DM test distortion (arXiv:2605.16866): conventional HAC t-stat critical values distorted when forecast error distributions have infinite variance (Lévy-stable tails). May affect Strategy A crypto IC tests. Not applicable to Strategy C (equity index futures).
